v1_results_status: v1 results are preserved unchanged. v1 L1-L3 are re-described as cross-validation confirmation folds (artifacts/r2/audit_v1_independence.json); they were never an isolated outer evaluation.

isolation.inner_stage: inner folds I1..I6 use only the inner population (6,249 images). During inner runs the features of all 1,751 outer-exclusion images are overwritten with NaN, so any use fails loudly.
isolation.outer_stage: O1 and O2 are protected (role 'outer'). They are scored only through a recipe registered in research_r2/frozen_recipes.json after the inner selection is committed, and exactly once.
isolation.frozen_feature_extraction: Backbone features for all 8,000 images were extracted earlier by frozen pretrained networks (no fitting, no statistics). Extraction is per image and independent of every other image.
isolation.researcher_exposure: NOT researcher-blind. Every outer composition was analysed in v1. The replayed candidate set (Stage D) was designed after seeing v1 Stage C results that used outer images in fitting. v2 gives data isolation for a mechanical replay, not a fresh scientific test.

inner_replay.unchanged_from_v1: row configurations, methods, gamma grid 0..16 step 0.25, primary metric H_bal@1 with leave-one-fold-out gamma over the inner folds

requires_all: mean primary improvement >= 1.0 percentage point over the six inner folds
primary improves in at least 5 of 6 inner folds (paired)
mean calibrated healthy-shortcut rate increases by no more than 5 percentage points

mechanical_selection.rule: start at B1_clipL_factorised; among its children that pass the gate against it, move to the one with the highest primary (ties: first listed); repeat; the node where no child passes is selected. Implemented in scripts/r2_select_v2.py.

outer_scoring.rows: the selected node; B1_clipL_factorised (matched control); B0_clipL_zeroshot_comp (reference); and D2_synthComp_norm_text if it is not the selected node (so the v1 choice is always confirmed or refuted)
outer_scoring.gamma: for each row, its own pooled argmax of mean inner H_bal@1 over the inner folds. gamma = 8 (v1 value, which was chosen with outer images in fitting) is also reported and labelled non-isolated
report_separately: per-composition Top-1 with 95% composition-bootstrap intervals for the D2-minus-control difference
outer_scoring.official_test: never read; no official inference is part of this protocol
